name: Vacuum extension 100 mm
description: Short hollow extension for the hand vacuum. Front end: a 35 mm push-in plug matching the nozzle opening (41.8 mm wide, one long side flat, the other curved out, 18 mm high at the ends and 20 mm in the middle; 0.2 mm clearance plus two small crush ribs per long side, small lead-in). Back end: a socket for the thin tongue of the old brush extension, same width and curve but 3 mm thinner than the opening (15.2 mm high at the ends, 17.2 in the middle, centred), 0.1 mm clearance per side and small crush ribs inside. The old tongue ends in a wider collar that must stay outside and is slanted about 50 degrees to the axis, so the socket's rim is cut at that angle: the wall on the rounded side is about 13 mm shorter than on the flat side (socket 45 mm deep from the flat side's rim) and the collar lands flat on the rim. Straight air channel between. Prints standing on the plug end with the socket opening up, no supports. PETG or PLA, 3 perimeters. The old part's holes/latches are not copied: it holds by friction. Print the two short test pieces first. Not printed or fitted.
